passages.en: With the stones he built an altar in the LORD’s name. He made a trench around the altar large enough to contain two seahs of seed.
passages.ko: 저가 여호와의 이름을 의지하여 그 돌로 단을 쌓고 단으로 돌아가며 곡식 종자 두 세아를 용납할만한 도랑을 만들고

passages.en: He put the wood in order, and cut the bull in pieces and laid it on the wood. He said, “Fill four jars with water, and pour it on the burnt offering and on the wood.”
passages.ko: 또 나무를 벌이고 송아지의 각을 떠서 나무 위에 놓고 이르되 통 넷에 물을 채워다가 번제물과 나무 위에 부으라 하고

passages.en: He said, “Do it a second time;” and they did it the second time. He said, “Do it a third time;” and they did it the third time.

passages.en: The water ran around the altar; and he also filled the trench with water.

passages.en: At the time of the evening offering, Elijah the prophet came near and said, “LORD, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known today that you are God in Israel and that I am your servant, and that I have done all these things at your word.
passages.ko: 저녁 소제 드릴 때에 이르러 선지자 엘리야가 나아가서 말하되 아브라함과 이삭과 이스라엘의 하나님 여호와여 주께서 이스라엘 중에서 하나님이 되심과 내가 주의 종이 됨과 내가 주의 말씀대로 이 모든 일을 행하는 것을 오늘날 알게 하옵소서

passages.en: Hear me, LORD, hear me, that this people may know that you, LORD, are God, and that you have turned their heart back again.”

passages.en: Then the LORD’s fire fell and consumed the burnt offering, the wood, the stones, and the dust; and it licked up the water that was in the trench.

passages.en: When all the people saw it, they fell on their faces. They said, “The LORD, he is God! The LORD, he is God!”

passages.en: Elijah said to them, “Seize the prophets of Baal! Don’t let one of them escape!” They seized them; and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and killed them there.

passages.en: Elijah said to Ahab, “Get up, eat and drink; for there is the sound of abundance of rain.”

passages.en: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he bowed himself down on the earth, and put his face between his knees.

passages.en: He said to his servant, “Go up now and look toward the sea.” He went up and looked, then said, “There is nothing.” He said, “Go again” seven times.
passages.ko: 그 사환에게 이르되 올라가 바다편을 바라보라 저가 올라가 바라보고 고하되 아무것도 없나이다 가로되 일곱번까지 다시 가라

passages.en: On the seventh time, he said, “Behold, a small cloud, like a man’s hand, is rising out of the sea.” He said, “Go up, tell Ahab, ‘Get ready and go down, so that the rain doesn’t stop you.’”

passages.en: In a little while, the sky grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.

passages.en: The LORD’s hand was on Elijah; and he tucked his cloak into his belt and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
